title.zh: 整合：帶外國朋友吃熱炒
title.en: Review: Taking Friends to a Rechao Place

scenario.title: 熱炒店、台啤、乾杯文化
scenario.context: 第八章的收尾：帶外國朋友去熱炒店。你要介紹菜色、解釋台灣的乾杯文化、回答「你不喝嗎？」這種否定問句、用 So do I / Neither do I 附和，還要委婉地拒絕再來一杯。這一章的細膩表達全部派上用場。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Wow, this place is loud! I love it.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Welcome to rechao. It's basically a Taiwanese stir-fry restaurant, and it's pretty much made for drinking with friends.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到熱炒店。基本上就是台式快炒店，幾乎就是為了跟朋友喝酒而存在的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No, we don't. Everything's on the wall. Let's get clams with basil, three-cup chicken, and stir-fried water spinach.
lines.zh: 不需要，菜單都在牆上。我們點九層塔炒蛤蜊、三杯雞、炒空心菜。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Neither had I until I moved here. It's absolutely amazing.
lines.zh: 我搬來這裡之前也沒吃過，超級好吃。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: And a few bottles of Taiwan Beer, of course. It's always served ice cold.
lines.zh: 當然還有幾瓶台啤，這裡總是冰得透心涼。

lines.speaker: Uncle
lines.en: (at the next table, raising a glass) Ganbei!

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: What's happening? Why is he toasting us?
lines.zh: 發生什麼事？他為什麼跟我們敬酒？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's a thing here. "Ganbei" literally means "dry the glass," so it's basically bottoms up.
lines.zh: 這是這裡的文化。「乾杯」字面意思是把杯子喝乾，基本上就是 bottoms up。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Wait, I have to chug the whole thing?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: You don't have to. Just say "suíyì," which means "as much as you like."
lines.zh: 不用。你就說「隨意」，意思是想喝多少就喝多少。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Good, because I'm already a bit tipsy.
lines.zh: 好，因為我已經有點微醺了。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Yes, I am. So I'd better stop now, or I'll have a terrible hangover.
lines.zh: 要，我要上班。所以我最好現在停，不然明天會宿醉得很慘。

patterns.en: Let me order for the table.
You don't have to finish it.

chinglish.wrong: A: Don't you drink? B: Yes, I don't drink.
chinglish.right: B: No, I don't. / Right, I don't drink.
chinglish.why: 複習第 75 單元：回答否定問句只看事實。

chinglish.wrong: Ganbei means you must drink all.
chinglish.right: Ganbei literally means "dry the glass," but you don't have to finish it.
chinglish.why: 解釋文化時要完整，而且別嚇到外國朋友。

chinglish.wrong: I'm a little drunk very much.
chinglish.right: I'm a bit tipsy. / I'm pretty drunk.
chinglish.why: 複習第 74 單元：程度詞只選一個。

chinglish.wrong: My head is very pain tomorrow.
chinglish.right: I'll have a terrible hangover tomorrow.
chinglish.why: 複習第 8 單元：pain 是名詞；宿醉說 hangover。

grammar.title: 否定疑問、簡答、程度副詞
grammar.oneLiner: 社交場合的三個細節：否定問句只看事實回答、So / Neither 附和、用程度詞精準表達感受。
whenToUse: 否定問句：Aren't you…? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.（只看事實）
附和肯定：So do I / So am I / Me too。
附和否定：Neither do I / Neither had I / Me neither。
程度詞：a bit tipsy / pretty good / absolutely amazing（極端形容詞用 absolutely）。
委婉拒絕：I'm good for now / I'll pass this time / I'd better not（第 34、71 單元）。
招待用祈使句：Help yourself / Try this one（第 77 單元）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 這一章教的都是「細節」：中文不需要區分的肯定否定回答、附和時的助動詞、程度詞的強弱。在熱炒店這種熱鬧、要快速反應的場合，台灣人最容易回到中文習慣。整合單元的目的是讓這些細節變成反射動作。

examples.correct: A: Aren't you hungry? B: Yes, I'm starving!
A: I've never had stinky tofu. B: Neither have I!

examples.incorrect: The clams are very delicious very.

examples.correct: I'm a bit tipsy, so I'll switch to tea.
A: More beer? B: I'm good for now, thanks.

quiz.question: A: Don't you like beer? B: (你不喜歡) ___
options: No, I don't. I prefer tea.
quiz.explanation: 不喜歡就說 No, I don't。

quiz.question: A: I'm so full. B: ___
quiz.explanation: be 動詞對應 So am I。

quiz.question: A: I've never been to a rechao place. B: Neither ___ I!
Someone offers you another beer, but you've had enough. You say:
quiz.explanation: I'm good for now 委婉拒絕。

slang.usage: 舉杯時說，意思是把杯底朝天喝光。比 Cheers 更強調「喝乾」。

risk.note: 在英美很少真的要求別人喝光，逼人乾杯可能讓外國朋友不舒服。

examples.en: Here's to the new job. Bottoms up!
In Taiwan, "ganbei" is like saying "bottoms up."
examples.zh: 在台灣，「乾杯」就像是說 bottoms up。

slang.usage: 比 drunk 輕，帶點愉快的醉意。

examples.en: I'm a little tipsy after two beers.
examples.zh: 兩杯啤酒我就有點微醺了。

risk.note: 跟主管說自己 hungover 可能不太專業。

examples.en: I have a terrible hangover. Never again.
examples.zh: 我宿醉超嚴重，再也不喝了。

examples.en: Drink lots of water so you don't get a hangover.

slang.usage: 大口快速喝完飲料，常用在喝酒遊戲。

risk.note: 帶有派對、喝酒遊戲的意味，工作聚會少用。

examples.en: He chugged the whole bottle in ten seconds.
You don't have to chug it. Just sip.
examples.zh: 你不用一口氣喝完，慢慢喝就好。

review.question: As soon as we ___, the owner brought us beer.
review.explanation: 複習第 79 單元：as soon as + 過去式。

review.question: My uncle is ___ making us drink more at family dinners! (老是)
review.explanation: 複習第 78 單元：always + 進行式。

review.question: A: I can't drink much. B: ___
review.explanation: 複習第 76 單元：否定附和。

review.question: A: Isn't this place amazing? B: (你同意) ___
review.explanation: 複習第 75 單元：事實是肯定就說 Yes。

review.question: I'm ___ full. I can't eat another bite.
review.explanation: 複習第 74 單元：強烈程度。

review.question: ___ you try the stinky tofu? It's better than it smells.
review.explanation: 複習第 73 單元：Why don't you…?

review.question: ___ I love about rechao is the atmosphere.
review.explanation: 複習第 72 單元：What 分裂句。

review.question: Remember ___ water between beers.
review.explanation: 複習第 71 單元：remember to V。

review.question: If I hadn't had that last beer, I ___ a hangover.
